profile.name: Mecademic机械臂
profile.description: 用于实验自动化的机械臂控制对象，可执行机器人激活、回零/归位、断开连接，并检查IO模块状态；同时包含运动队列参数与初始化配置的脏标记管理，便于在测试或实验前将机器人恢复到已知状态。
profile.description_en: A robotic arm control object for lab automation that can activate the robot, home it, disconnect it, and check IO module presence. It also manages dirty-state tracking for motion queue parameters and initialization settings so the robot can be restored to a known state before experiments or tests.

rows.profile_value: 用于实验自动化的机械臂控制对象，可执行机器人激活、回零/归位、断开连接，并检查IO模块状态；同时包含运动队列参数与初始化配置的脏标记管理，便于在测试或实验前将机器人恢复到已知状态。

A robotic arm control object for lab automation that can activate the robot, home it, disconnect it, and check IO module presence. It also manages dirty-state tracking for motion queue parameters and initialization settings so the robot can be restored to a known state before experiments or tests.
